beats.line: In Evin prison in Iran there is a punishment so terrifying
that it strikes fear into the hearts of even the most hardened criminals
It is simply known as the White Room
This is a small all-white isolation cell
where the bright overhead lights never turn off
and all outside noise and human contact cease to exist
Your playthrough of this nightmare begins with you being dressed in all-white clothes
before being thrown into a completely soundproof all-white cell. The bed,
the walls, the floors, and even the plate
and food you receive are all completely white
